assertion: Maine electricity prices rose 64 percent between 2019 and 2025, compared with a 38 percent average increase nationwide.
inaccuracy: EIA residential prices rose 54.8% in Maine and 32.4% nationally (all sectors 60.4% vs 28.7%), not 64% and 38%; the measure behind the article's figures is unknown.
sql: SELECT state_abbr, sector, price_year, avg_price_cents_kwh FROM energy.eia_electricity_prices WHERE state_abbr IN ('ME','US') AND price_year IN (2019,2025) AND sector IN ('residential','all sectors')
